 Notes

We have an auto update functionality, that fetches superfile's latest released version from github (if last timestamp of last version check was less than 24 hours) and prints a prompt to user, if there is a newer version available.

You can turn this off, by setting auto check update to false in superfile config. Click me to see the config wiki 

 Troubleshooting

 Click me to see common problem fix 

 Uninstalling

 macOS and Linux

 

If you want to inspect the script, see : uninstall.sh

Besides the spf binary in /usr/local/bin or /.local/bin , the script also deletes your config and data folders: /.config/superfile , /.local/share/superfile and /.local/state/superfile (or the $XDG HOME locations if you set them, on Linux or macOS), and /Library/Application Support/superfile on macOS.

 Windows

To uninstall superfile on Windows, use this powershell script.

 

This script does not remove your config and data folder. Delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\superfile manually if you want it gone.

 Other install methods

If you installed superfile another way (for example with a package manager), run spf pl before uninstalling to see where your config and data folders are, then delete them yourself. See config file path for all locations.

install.html:
macOS and Linux
bash -c "$(curl -sLo- https://superfile.dev/install.sh)"

If you want to inspect the script, see : install.sh

Windows
Powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Invoke-Expression ((New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://superfile.dev/install.ps1'))"

If you want to inspect the script, see : install.ps1

Winget
winget install --id yorukot.superfile
Scoop
scoop install superfile
